macro_forecast.title: Terminal Unwinding of the Post-WWII Global Order (CASS 94%)
macro_forecast.statement: The four pillars of the post-WWII order (Pax Americana, Bretton Woods/dollar hegemony, technocratic neutrality, corporate apoliticalism) have simultaneously crossed their complexity caps. Their unwinding is irreversible under current institutional parameters — a systemic phase transition, not cyclical volatility. Reversion to factional capitalism, regionalized logistics, and hard-power competition is already underway.
